metadata.title: On Submanifolds with constant Möbius Ricci curvature
metadata.abstract: In the Möbius geometry of submanifolds there exists an important Möbius invariant tensor called the Möbius metric which together with the Möbius second fundamental form, the Blaschke tensor and the Möbius form constitute a complete system of conformal invariants for umbilic-free submanifolds when the dimension $n \geq 3$. An umbilic-free immersion $f:M^{n}\to \mathbb{R}^{m}$ is said to have constant Möbius Ricci curvature if its Möbius metric has constant Ricci curvature. In this paper, we classify umbilic-free immersions $f:M^{n}\to \mathbb{R}^{m}$ with constant Möbius Ricci curvature, flat normal bundle and two distinct principal normal vector fields. We prove that a submanifold with constant Möbius Ricci curvature and flat normal bundle has closed Möbius form, and then we classify such submanifolds provided the Möbius form vanishes identically on $M^{n}$.

analysis.workSummary: 对n≥3的无脐浸入，研究Möbius度量的常Ricci条件。在平坦法丛且有两个不同主法向量场的情形进行分类，并证明常Möbius Ricci且法丛平坦时Möbius形式闭。
techniques: 平坦法丛和主法向量分解
analysis.breakthrough: 在Möbius形式恒为零的额外条件下给进一步分类，将Ricci约束转化成共形不变量的结构限制。
analysis.limitations: 闭形式与恒零形式的条件不同，第二个分类额外假设恒零。需对照局部/整体范围、主法向量重数及Ricci规范。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第17页致谢为基金支持。17页PDF完整提取，全文关键词语境和补充点写AI、拆行模型名及Danus检索未观察到实际使用披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 曲率条件和子流形刚性紧密相关。
